nusmp.page.book_compass.needle_flick: Flicks one golden compass needle straight ahead; the first foe it touches takes a light hit.
nusmp.page.book_compass.bearing_step: Takes a bearing and steps up to 8 blocks forward along it, a short move without a hit.
nusmp.page.book_compass.magnetic_pull: Draws the foe under your crosshair in towards you with a magnetic tug and hits it lightly on the way.
nusmp.page.book_compass.true_heading: The compass settles on true north: you run faster for ten seconds and your melee hits carry a little extra weight.
nusmp.page.book_compass.lodestone_snare: A lodestone needle pins one foe in place: heavy slowness for a few seconds and a small hit (shares the control cooldown).
nusmp.page.book_compass.cardinal_volley: Four homing needles, one for each cardinal point, each seeking a different foe.
nusmp.page.book_compass.declination_wave: A wave of bent magnetic force in front of you that hurts and shoves foes far off their line.
nusmp.page.book_compass.dead_reckoning: Plots a straight course and drives a long needle along it, hitting everything on the line.
nusmp.page.book_compass.safe_bearing: The compass points the way to safety: you and your allies nearby regain a part of their health.
nusmp.page.book_compass.magnetic_storm: A storm of scattered needles at the aim point for four seconds: foes inside are hit every half second and dragged slow.
nusmp.page.book_compass.meridian_lance: A huge needle along the meridian: a long, wide line that hits hard and shoves foes along it.
nusmp.page.book_compass.cardinal_burst: All four points of the compass fire at once in a ring around you, hurting and knocking back everything close.
